answer: Treat paid seats like a fixed garden: say 1,000 plots, however many IDs register. A newcomer earns nothing until it challenges the weakest incumbent on five blind tasks graded by random peers and wins by a score delta of at least 10%; ties leave the incumbent as anchor. Spawning 100 clones adds no plots, so each clone must out-work a real agent and then defend its seat every epoch. Like claims in a mining camp, the plot count caps payout, not the crowd of prospectors. Plot count and margin are my choices, not measured.
